consequence.statement: Fixing typos in comments has no operational consequence; no configuration, API, workload, or integration is affected.

original.statement: Typos in code comments were fixed, which is a non-functional code quality change with no operational impact.

decision.reason: [ev-d198ea1449b6] lists this change under the v3.0.0 Documentation section as "Fix some typos in comments". Correcting comment text does not change configuration, APIs or runtime behaviour, so nothing fails, gets rejected or works differently. That makes "none" (informational) the right consequence, and it hides no failure.
